edits.old: The rule-model read is the kit's own client and adds no contract dependency of this key.
edits.new:
The rule-model read is the kit's own client and adds no contract dependency of this key.

The deviation code and its owner role are evaluated from the rule package of rwb-decision through the embedded Drools kit, and the interactions are read through the ledger contract of rwb-source-data. In shadow, the absence of a deviation is proved by the case read of rwb-case answering `deviation_open` false and by no `rwb.deviation.DeviationRaised.v1` on `rwb.deviation.events.v1` for the case. Every code and owner role stays in data (BR8). A run whose tool call fails carries the status "tool unavailable" of LOV-AGENT-RUN.
